_INSTRUCTIONS.note: This file contains crossword puzzles organized by CEFR difficulty level
_INSTRUCTIONS.easy: A1-A2 level: Use common vocabulary (4-7 letters). Clues use basic vocabulary and simple sentences.
_INSTRUCTIONS.medium: B1 level: Use intermediate vocabulary. Clues can be more complex but clear.
_INSTRUCTIONS.hard: B2-C1 level: Use advanced vocabulary. Clues can be sophisticated.
_INSTRUCTIONS.important: Each level MUST have exactly 8 words. Choose words that share common letters (A,E,I,O,R,S,T,N) for better crossword generation.
_INSTRUCTIONS.tip: Match the vocabulary in clues to the same CEFR level as the word
